items.title: Data Analytics Dashboard USA 2022
items.desc: An interactive dashboard that displays metrics related to traffic accident reports in the United States in 2022.

detail.overview: This project involved building a comprehensive data analytics dashboard to visualize and explore traffic accident data across the United States for the year 2022. The dashboard provides interactive filters, geospatial visualizations, and key performance metrics.
features: Interactive map visualization of accident hotspots by state and county
Time-series charts showing accident trends by month, day, and hour
Filterable views by severity, weather conditions, and road type
Export functionality for filtered datasets
Automated data refresh pipeline

items.title: Hadoop v3
items.desc: Documentation of the verification of the installation of Hadoop v3 on a virtual machine running the Debian/Linux operating system.

detail.overview: A detailed walkthrough documenting the step-by-step installation and verification of Apache Hadoop v3 on a Debian/Linux virtual machine. Covers environment setup, configuration files, and validation commands.
features: Installation of Java JDK and configuration of environment variables
Hadoop v3 download, extraction, and directory setup
Configuration of core-site.xml, hdfs-site.xml, mapred-site.xml, and yarn-site.xml
SSH key setup for passwordless node communication
Formatting HDFS and starting the Hadoop cluster
Verification via JPS and web UI access

items.title: MapReduce in Hadoop v3
items.desc: Documentation of the use of MapReduce with Hadoop v3 on a sample text file.

detail.overview: This project demonstrates a hands-on MapReduce job execution on Hadoop v3. A classic word count example is implemented and executed to verify the MapReduce framework functionality on a distributed filesystem.
features: Word Count MapReduce job implementation in Java
JAR compilation and submission to the Hadoop cluster
Input file preparation on HDFS
Job execution and monitoring via YARN ResourceManager
Output retrieval and result verification

items.title: Trata de Personas Perú 2017-2025
items.desc: Dashboard interactivo sobre trata de personas en el Perú, con datos recopilados de diversas fuentes gubernamentales.

detail.overview: This project presents an interactive dashboard analyzing human trafficking cases in Peru from 2017 to 2025. Data was collected from government sources and organized into an interactive Power BI dashboard to visualize trends, affected regions, victim profiles, and prosecution statistics.
features: Interactive Power BI dashboard with geospatial visualizations by region
Time-series analysis of trafficking cases from 2017 to 2025
Victim demographics breakdown by age, gender, and origin
Filterable views by trafficking type and year
Prosecution and conviction statistics tracking
